newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean KFPC buys 50,000 tonnes corn from Toepfer.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean KFPC buys 50,000 tonnes corn from Toepfer.

text.p: The Korea Feedgrain Purchase Committee (KFPC) on Thursday bought 50,000 tonnes of corn from Toepfer at $125.47 a tonne C&F, traders said.
Traders said arrival was set for October 10 to the western port of Inchon.
Shipment was set for August 22-September 10 from the U.S. Gulf and for September 11-30 from the Pacific Northwest.
The seller can also deliver Chinese corn at $121.47 a tonne C&F, they said.
